title: A worker's brief and role file say to commit its work in progress on work/<id> before its turn cap and report what is left
goal: the brief's fixed rules state the worker's turn cap, the turn by which it commits what it has on work/<id> with KB-Work and that it reports what is left; the kb-worker role file says the same for a session whose brief carries no cap, so a worker that nears its cap never exits with staged changes

run: import re,subprocess,sys;f=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/backlog.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout;cap=int(re.search(r'--max-turns (\d+)',f('dispatch','--dry-run','TK-dcgp3kd2')).group(1));r=f('brief','TK-dcgp3kd2').split('## Fixed rules',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];m=re.search(r'by turn (\d+)',r);sys.exit(0 if m and 5<=cap-int(m.group(1))<=30 else 1)
import sys;t=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'work in progress' in t and 'turn cap' in t else 1)

clauses.clause: the brief's fixed rules state the worker's turn cap, the turn by which it commits what it has on work/<id> with KB-Work and that it reports what is left
the kb-worker role file says the same for a session whose brief carries no cap, so a worker that nears its cap never exits with staged changes

gates.question: How many turns before its cap must a worker have committed its work in progress?
